title: Open direct image under reduction of the ambient scheme
statement: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-weil-open-immersion, def-pc-scheme]. Let $r:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ and $s:U_{\mathrm{red}}\to U$ be their reductions [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction], and let $j_{\mathrm{red}}:U_{\mathrm{red}}\hookrightarrow X_{\mathrm{red}}$ be the induced open immersion. For any commutative ring $\Lambda$ and any sheaf $F$ of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], there is a $\Lambda$-linear isomorphism, natural in $F$, $$j_*F\ \cong\ r_*j_{\mathrm{red},*}s^{-1}F.$$ Here direct and inverse image are those of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] for constant coefficient rings. No reducedness, Noetherianity, finiteness or constructibility assumption on $X$, $\Lambda$ or $F$ is imposed.
